description:
You are a Law Enforcement Officer coordinating a multi-team field training exercise at a regional park reserve. You are building a GPS data package that will be loaded onto team leaders' handheld GPS units before the exercise begins.

BaseCamp starts with an empty library (no prior data). Create all waypoints and routes from scratch.

Create these 7 waypoints in My Collection with exact names, coordinates, symbols, and comments:

1. Name: PATROL BASE FOXTROT  |  Lat: 42.4450  Lon: -71.1120  |  Symbol: Flag, Blue  |  Comment: PB FOXTROT. Main staging. Vehicles: 4 patrol + 2 plain. Post-op debrief here.
2. Name: OBJ ALPHA TARGET  |  Lat: 42.4540  Lon: -71.0980  |  Symbol: Flag, Red  |  Comment: PRIMARY OBJ ALPHA. Building complex. Approach from SE axis. Evacuate 100m radius.
3. Name: OBJ BRAVO COMMS  |  Lat: 42.4380  Lon: -71.0920  |  Symbol: Flag, Red  |  Comment: SECONDARY OBJ BRAVO. Comms relay structure. Team 2 only. Jam frequencies on approach.
4. Name: RP1 CHECKPOINT IRON  |  Lat: 42.4480  Lon: -71.1060  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: Rally Point 1 IRON. Hold-short position. Confirm radio comms Team 1+2 before proceeding.
5. Name: RP2 CHECKPOINT STEEL  |  Lat: 42.4420  Lon: -71.1000  |  Symbol: Waypoint  |  Comment: Rally Point 2 STEEL. Medevac LZ 200m NE. Report status before exfil.
6. Name: LZ YANKEE MEDEVAC  |  Lat: 42.4360  Lon: -71.1040  |  Symbol: Airport  |  Comment: LZ YANKEE. Cleared 60x60m. Obstacles: 3 trees W side. Medevac ETA 8 min.
7. Name: BP NORTH BLOCK  |  Lat: 42.4590  Lon: -71.0870  |  Symbol: Flag, Green  |  Comment: Blocking Position NORTH. Prevent exfil N axis. Team 3: 2 officers. Establish at H-15.

Create these 3 routes:

Route 1 — Name: ROUTE BLACK PRIMARY  |  Waypoints in order: PATROL BASE FOXTROT, RP1 CHECKPOINT IRON, OBJ ALPHA TARGET, RP2 CHECKPOINT STEEL, PATROL BASE FOXTROT
Route 2 — Name: ROUTE RED ALTERNATE  |  Waypoints in order: PATROL BASE FOXTROT, OBJ BRAVO COMMS, RP2 CHECKPOINT STEEL, OBJ ALPHA TARGET, RP1 CHECKPOINT IRON, PATROL BASE FOXTROT
Route 3 — Name: ROUTE GREEN EXFIL  |  Waypoints in order: OBJ ALPHA TARGET, LZ YANKEE MEDEVAC, BP NORTH BLOCK, PATROL BASE FOXTROT

When done, export the entire My Collection as a GPX file and save it to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\TacOp_Exercise_Foxtrot.gpx
